title: Data-Driven Time-Varying Control Barrier Functions for Adaptive Safe-Set Learning with Online Decremental Support Vector Machines
abstract: arXiv:2608.19366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mission-critical intelligent systems often operate under time-varying limitations that reduce control authority and change the admissible safe operating envelope. In such settings, a safety certificate learned under nominal conditions may become invalid as system capability changes. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a degradation-aware, data-driven safety-filtering framework that learns a safe set from data, updates it online, and enforces the resulting learned barrier through a time-varying control barrier function (CBF). A nominal safe envelope is first learned from operational data using a radial basis function (RBF)-kernel support vector machine (SVM), whose decision function serves as the initial CBF candidate. To capture capability-induced safe-set contraction, a continuous-time decremental SVM update law is developed so that selected support-vector coefficients are reduced according to a degradation signal. tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数据驱动和时间变化控制屏障函数的自适应安全过滤框架，通过在线递减支持向量机动态更新安全集，以应对系统能力退化导致的安全证书失效问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven time-varying control barrier function framework with online decremental support vector machines to adaptively update safety sets under system capability degradation.
